```{r setup, message=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(BPCells)
library(ggtext)

annotations <- readRDS("./final_cluster_assignments_integrated_dset.rds")

mb_ge <- open_matrix_dir(
  "./rosmap_mb_prepro/decontx_counts/"
)
mb_neurons <- annotations %>%
  filter(dataset != "hypoad", broadclass == "neuron")

hypoad_ge <- open_matrix_dir("./hypoad_prepro/hypoad_counts_bpcells_mat/")
hypoad_neurons <- annotations %>%
  filter(dataset == "hypoad", broadclass == "neuron")

genes_of_interest <- c(
  "KCNC2", "FOXB1", "MEIS2", "EBF2",
  "ST6GALNAC5", "EPS8", "SLC17A6", "SLC32A1"
)
```


```{r}
make_dotplot <- function(ge_matrix,
                         cell_meta,
                         selected_genes,
                         cluster_col = "cluster_number",
                         cell_id_col = "cell_id",
                         plot_title  = "",
                         y_label     = "Cluster") {

  cell_ids <- cell_meta[[cell_id_col]]
  clusters <- as.character(cell_meta[[cluster_col]])

  cur_ge <- ge_matrix[, cell_ids]

  cur_ge_ln <- multiply_cols(cur_ge, 1 / Matrix::colSums(cur_ge))
  cur_ge_ln <- log1p(cur_ge_ln * 1e6)

  percent_pb <- (cur_ge[selected_genes, ] > 0) %>%
    pseudobulk_matrix(cell_groups = clusters, method = "mean", threads = 8L)

  ln_pb <- cur_ge_ln[selected_genes, ] %>%
    pseudobulk_matrix(cell_groups = clusters, method = "mean", threads = 8L)

  dotplot_df <- data.frame()
  for (gene in selected_genes) {
    for (cluster in colnames(ln_pb)) {
      avg_exp <- ln_pb[gene, cluster]
      pct_exp <- percent_pb[gene, cluster] * 100
      dotplot_df <- rbind(dotplot_df,
                          data.frame(gene    = gene,
                                     cluster = cluster,
                                     avg_exp = avg_exp,
                                     pct_exp = pct_exp))
    }
  }

  dotplot_df$gene <- factor(dotplot_df$gene, levels = selected_genes)

  # Build cluster grouping lookup
  cluster_groups <- cell_meta %>%
    select(all_of(c(cluster_col, "cluster"))) %>%
    distinct() %>%
    arrange(cluster, .data[[cluster_col]])

  cluster_order <- as.character(cluster_groups[[cluster_col]])
  dotplot_df$cluster <- factor(dotplot_df$cluster, levels = cluster_order)

  # Add parent cluster group to dotplot_df
  group_lookup <- setNames(cluster_groups$cluster, as.character(cluster_groups[[cluster_col]]))
  dotplot_df$cluster_group <- group_lookup[as.character(dotplot_df$cluster)]
  dotplot_df$cluster_group <- factor(dotplot_df$cluster_group,
                                     levels = unique(cluster_groups$cluster))

  ggplot(dotplot_df,
         aes(x = gene, y = cluster, fill = avg_exp, size = pct_exp)) +
    geom_point(shape = 21, color = "black") +
    facet_grid(cluster_group ~ ., scales = "free_y", space = "free_y",
               switch = "y") +
    scale_size_area(max_size = 15, name = "Percent\nExpressed") +
    scale_fill_gradient2(
      mid = "white", high = "#D55E00", low = "#0072B2",
      name = "Mean Log\nExpression"
    ) +
    ggtitle(plot_title) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 15) +
    scale_x_discrete(guide = guide_axis(angle = 45)) +
    theme(
      plot.title       = element_text(face = "bold", size = 30, hjust = 0.5),
      axis.title.x     = element_text(face = "bold", size = 25),
      axis.title.y     = element_text(face = "bold", size = 25),
      axis.text.x      = element_text(face = "bold.italic", size = 17),
      axis.text.y      = element_text(face = "bold", size = 17),
      legend.title     = element_text(face = "bold"),
      legend.text      = element_text(face = "bold", size = 20),
      legend.position  = "right",
      legend.key.size  = unit(0.5, "cm"),
      strip.placement  = "outside",
      strip.text.y.left = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14, angle = 0),
      strip.background = element_rect(fill = NA, colour = "black"),
      panel.spacing    = unit(0.15, "lines")
    ) +
    labs(x = "Gene", y = y_label)
}
```

```{r}
mb_plot <- make_dotplot(
  ge_matrix      = mb_ge,
  cell_meta      = mb_neurons,
  selected_genes = genes_of_interest,
  plot_title     = "Marker Genes – Medial MB Human Neurons"
)
mb_plot

hypoad_plot <- make_dotplot(
  ge_matrix      = hypoad_ge,
  cell_meta      = hypoad_neurons,
  selected_genes = genes_of_interest,
  plot_title     = "Marker Genes – HypoAD Neurons"
)
hypoad_plot
library(patchwork)

full_marker = mb_plot / hypoad_plot

ggsave("marker human.pdf",full_marker, width = 20, height = 20)
```
